patch_description: This rewrite uses aggressive parameter sharing by tying pre- and post-entanglement RZ gates to the same per-wire class parameters (rz_corner, rz_edge, rz_center). It also keeps shared RY parameters (ry_corner, ry_edge, ry_center) and a shared hub parameter (hub_angle) across CRZ and CRX on center-to-edge connections. The result is a leaner per-block parameter count (7 keys instead of 10), reducing overfitting and train-time, while preserving expressive power through layer-wise RY/RZ and CZCRZ/CRX interactions. This should improve validation/test performance and reduce generalization gap with fewer parameters and similar or better train efficiency.
